verdict.rationale: Supabase Edge Functions are documented as server-side TypeScript functions distributed globally at the edge, invoked without managing servers, and are listed alongside other core managed services (Auth, Data APIs, Realtime, Storage). This directly matches the story of deploying serverless functions callable via HTTP or SDK. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence (e.g., community reports) specifically validating Edge Functions invocation reliability or SDK-call ergonomics beyond first-party docs.
